summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title), gated only on is_terminal and returning a bool, with the required docstring caveats; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading with a PR 2200 bullet under Unreleased; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black were not executed per instructions, so formatting and type-checking are unverified. Nothing was committed.
